notes: A destruction sandbox is Simulation: breakable assemblies whose reactions are the entertainment is physics-rig, the exact thing Roblox physics sims are built on, and the author confirmed there is no score and no target, which rules out the scored or objective genres. Shape is Simulation's world-open, one shared persistent world everyone knocks down together, since nobody owns a plot here and there is no tier ladder or hub loop. I kept the Physics Sim preset's shape and its physics-rig, but dropped hazard-kill because no disaster or environmental event was asked for - the players are the hazard - and dropped path-circulation because there is no hub or production the streets would need to chain. Settlement-density carries the author's modern city of streets, skyscrapers, offices and shops at city-block density; with no user to ask I treated the buildings as facades rather than enterable interiors, since nothing in the brief puts the player indoors and that keeps the build on P0.
